ega_details_data: Stores machine-wise, hourly production and EGA (Extra Give Away) related metrics for packing machines. Data is captured every one hour per machine and includes pack counts, actual vs theoretical weight, EGA limits, EGA loss in grams and percentage, speed, runtime, and over-scale/over-weight statistics. This table is primarily used to analyze product giveaway, compliance with EGA limits, and packing efficiency by loop, machine, grammage (SKU), variant, and time period.
oee_details_data: Stores hourly machine-wise OEE, downtime, speed loss, errors, production output and wastage data for packing machines. Data is captured every one hour using start_time and end_time and can be aggregated by shift, date, loop, machine, grammage (SKU) and preset.
wastage_records: Stores shift-wise wastage and production rejection data entered manually by operators, JTAs, or shift in-charges. The table captures total wastage quantity, wastage reasons, production rejection, and unaccounted downtime details for packing machines. Data can be analyzed by plant, line, machine, shift, product, flavour, and grammage. JSON breakdown columns store category-wise wastage and downtime reason details.
employees_list: Stores master employee details including employee names, assigned operational roles such as Operator, JTA (Junior Technical Assistant), and Shift Incharge, along with their current active employment status. This table is used for tracking workforce assignments and validation across production and shift-based operations.
production_speed_details_data: Stores hourly machine production speed details for each machine including plant unit, loop, variant, grammage, and customer information. Each record represents one hour of machine operation. The table captures detailed minute-level speed tracking and summarized 5-minute interval speed readings. It is primarily used for performance monitoring, speed trend analysis, production efficiency evaluation, and OEE-related calculations.
gsm_usage_details: Stores GSM material usage details shift-wise including starting and ending weights for each material and vendor. Used to calculate vendor-wise material consumption.
